ex.en: I'll keep all the ideas we discussed for the upcoming project proposal.
ex.zh: 我會把我們討論過的所有想法留給下一個專案提案用。

ex.en: Tom has no intention of asking Mary to the upcoming dance.
ex.zh: 湯姆不打算邀瑪麗參加即將舉辦的舞會。

ex.en: Please check the schedule for upcoming events.
ex.zh: 請查看近期活動的時間表。

ex.en: Do you mind helping me carry this box upstairs?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我把這個箱子搬上樓嗎？

ex.en: My room is upstairs on the left.
ex.zh: 我的房間在樓上左邊。

ex.en: Would you carry my luggage upstairs?
ex.zh: 你可以把我的行李拿到樓上嗎?

upstairs.en: on or to a higher floor of a building

ex.en: It seems that the burglar broke in through an upstairs window.
ex.zh: 小偷似乎是從樓上的窗戶闖進來的。

ex.en: The upstairs bathroom is being repaired.
ex.zh: 樓上的浴室正在整修。

upstairs.en: on a higher floor of a building

ex.en: The smoke went upward through the chimney.
ex.zh: 煙從煙囪往上冒。

ex.en: He was looking upward to the sky.
ex.zh: 他抬頭望著天空。

upward.en: toward a higher place or level

ex.en: Prices continue their upward trend.
ex.zh: 價格持續上漲。

ex.en: There is upward pressure on salaries.
ex.zh: 薪資有上漲的壓力。

upward.en: moving toward a higher place or level

ex.en: Prices went up last month.
ex.zh: 上個月物價上漲了。

ex.en: Please stand up.
ex.zh: 請站起來。

up.en: toward a higher place, level or amount

ex.en: We used up all the paper.
ex.zh: 我們把紙都用完了。

ex.en: Finish up your work before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前把工作做完。

up.en: used to show that an action is done completely

ex.en: Are you up yet?
ex.zh: 你起床了嗎？

ex.en: I was up all night working.
ex.zh: 我熬夜工作了一整晚。

ex.en: It's up to you.
ex.zh: 由你決定。

ex.en: The hall holds up to 200 people.
ex.zh: 這個大廳最多可容納兩百人。

up.en: used to say who must decide, or the highest amount possible

ex.en: His life was full of ups and downs.
ex.zh: 他的人生充滿起起落落。

ex.en: In life there are ups and downs.
ex.zh: 人生總有起起伏伏。

up.en: good and bad times mixed together

ex.en: The upper reaches of the river are very beautiful.
ex.zh: 這條河的上游非常美。

ex.en: The meeting room is on the upper floor.
ex.zh: 會議室在樓上。

ex.en: Put the box on the upper shelf.
ex.zh: 把箱子放在上層架子。

upper.en: higher than another part, or at the top

ex.en: The company's upper management approved the plan.
ex.zh: 公司高層核准了這項計畫。

ex.en: Upper management will make the final decision.
ex.zh: 最後由高層主管做決定。

upper.en: higher in rank or social position

ex.en: He thought he had the upper hand, but I turned the tables on him.
ex.zh: 他以為自己佔了上風，但我反將了他一軍。

ex.en: Our team had the upper hand in the second half.
ex.zh: 我們隊在下半場佔了上風。

upper.en: a stronger position than another person in a contest

upset.zh: 難過的、心煩的、不高興的

ex.en: I didn't think that Tom would be so upset.
ex.zh: 我沒想到湯姆會這麼不高興。

ex.en: When someone's upset, it's best to stay quiet.
ex.zh: 有人心情不好的時候，最好保持安靜。

upset.en: unhappy and worried because something bad has happened

ex.en: I didn't mean to upset you.
ex.zh: 我不是故意讓你難過的。

ex.en: The news upset her a lot.
ex.zh: 這個消息讓她非常難過。

upset.en: to make someone feel unhappy or worried

ex.en: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
ex.zh: 自從合併打亂了一切，辦公室就一團混亂。

ex.en: The bad weather upset our travel plans.
ex.zh: 壞天氣打亂了我們的旅遊計畫。

upset.en: to spoil a plan or put things into disorder

ex.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.
ex.zh: 別吃太多，免得吃壞肚子。

ex.en: I have an upset stomach today.
ex.zh: 我今天肚子不舒服。

upset.en: sick or in pain in the stomach

ex.en: Her speech uplifted everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 她的演講鼓舞了在場的每個人。

ex.en: The new park has uplifted the whole neighborhood.
ex.zh: 新公園讓整個社區煥然一新。

uplift.en: to make someone feel happier and more hopeful, or to raise something

ex.en: The company expects an uplift in sales this quarter.
ex.zh: 公司預期這一季的銷售會成長。

ex.en: The good news gave the team a much-needed uplift.
ex.zh: 這個好消息替團隊打了一劑強心針。

uplift.en: a rise in amount or level, or a feeling of being happier and more hopeful

ex.en: A good education doesn't imply a good upbringing.
ex.zh: 受過良好的教育不代表就有良好的教養。

ex.en: She had a strict upbringing in a small village.
ex.zh: 她在一個小村莊裡受到嚴格的家教長大。

ex.en: His polite manners reflect a good upbringing.
ex.zh: 他禮貌的舉止反映出良好的家教。

upbringing.en: the way parents raise and teach a child

ex.en: Orders showed an upturn in March after a quiet start to the year.
ex.zh: 年初較為冷清後，三月訂單開始回升。

ex.en: The company delayed hiring until the upturn in demand looked stable.
ex.zh: 公司等到需求回升趨勢穩定後才恢復招募。

upturn.en: a change toward better or higher levels

ex.en: Sami uploaded the photos.
ex.zh: Sami 上傳了照片。

ex.en: Please upload the signed form before Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前上傳簽署完成的表格。

upload.en: to send a file from your computer to the internet

ex.en: The monthly fee covers landscaping and building upkeep.
ex.zh: 每月費用包含景觀整理和建築維護。

ex.en: Older homes often require more upkeep than buyers expect.
ex.zh: 老房子需要的維護往往比買家預期的多。

upkeep.en: the work or money needed to keep something in good condition

ex.en: The group booked an upscale restaurant for the award dinner.
ex.zh: 團隊為頒獎晚宴預訂了一間高級餐廳。

ex.en: The brand is moving into upscale skincare products.
ex.zh: 這個品牌正拓展高價位的護膚產品。

ex.en: You can upgrade your computer with more random access memory to make the PC faster.
ex.zh: 你可以加裝記憶體來升級電腦，讓它跑得更快。

ex.en: The airline upgraded us to business class.
ex.zh: 航空公司把我們升等到商務艙。

upgrade.en: to change to a better or newer version

ex.en: With this upgrade, one obvious impact is that users will be obliged to reset their passwords.
ex.zh: 這次升級最明顯的影響，是使用者必須重設密碼。

ex.en: We got a free room upgrade because it was our honeymoon.
ex.zh: 因為我們是來度蜜月，所以免費升等房型。

upgrade.en: a newer or better version of something, or the change to it

ex.en: Could I get you to update this data for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我更新這份資料嗎？

ex.en: Windows is updating.
ex.zh: Windows 正在更新。

ex.en: My PC is in the middle of an update.
ex.zh: 我的電腦正在更新。

update.en: to make something more modern by adding the newest information

ex.en: Thanks for the updates.
ex.zh: 謝謝你告訴我最新進度。

ex.en: Can you give me an update on the project?
ex.zh: 可以跟我說一下專案的最新進度嗎？

update.zh: keep someone updated：隨時告知最新狀況

ex.en: Please keep me updated.
ex.zh: 請隨時告訴我最新狀況。

ex.en: I'll keep you updated on any changes.
ex.zh: 有任何變動我會隨時通知你。

update.en: to keep telling someone the newest news about something

ex.en: The balloon floated slowly upwards.
ex.zh: 氣球慢慢地向上飄。

ex.en: She looked upwards and saw a bird.
ex.zh: 她抬頭向上看，看見一隻鳥。

ex.en: The tickets cost fifty dollars and upwards.
ex.zh: 票價五十元起跳。

ex.en: Children aged ten and upwards can join the class.
ex.zh: 十歲以上的孩子都可以參加這堂課。

upon.zh: 在…之上（on 的正式說法）

ex.en: Once upon a time, a king lived in a tall castle.
ex.zh: 從前從前，有一位國王住在高高的城堡裡。

ex.en: The cat sat upon the old wooden chair.
ex.zh: 那隻貓坐在老舊的木椅上。

ex.en: Upon arrival, please check in at the front desk.
ex.zh: 一抵達，請先到櫃檯辦理登記。

ex.en: Upon hearing the news, she burst into tears.
ex.zh: 一聽到這個消息，她就哭了出來。

ex.en: Judges must uphold the law fairly.
ex.zh: 法官必須公正地維護法律。

ex.en: The school works hard to uphold its high standards.
ex.zh: 學校努力維持它的高標準。

ex.en: The court decided to uphold the earlier decision.
ex.zh: 法院決定維持先前的判決。

ex.en: The higher court upheld the verdict.
ex.zh: 上級法院維持了原判。

ex.en: Please bring your seat to an upright position.
ex.zh: 請把座椅調回直立的位置。

ex.en: The old tree stayed upright after the storm.
ex.zh: 那棵老樹在暴風雨後仍然挺立。

ex.en: He sat upright in his chair and listened carefully.
ex.zh: 他在椅子上坐得挺直，專心聆聽。

ex.en: She stood upright despite feeling tired.
ex.zh: 儘管很累，她還是站得筆直。

ex.en: He is an upright man who always tells the truth.
ex.zh: 他是個正直的人，總是說實話。

ex.en: The town trusted its upright mayor.
ex.zh: 鎮上的人信任這位正直的市長。

ex.en: Sheep graze on the upland all summer.
ex.zh: 整個夏天綿羊都在高地上吃草。

ex.en: The village is surrounded by wide upland and forests.
ex.zh: 這個村子被廣闊的高地和森林環繞。

ex.en: The upland farms get a lot of rain.
ex.zh: 高地的農場雨量很多。

ex.en: They hiked through upland areas of the country.
ex.zh: 他們健行穿越該國的山地地區。

ex.en: The uprising began in the capital and spread quickly.
ex.zh: 這場起義從首都開始並迅速蔓延。

ex.en: History books describe the uprising against the king.
ex.zh: 歷史書描述了反抗國王的那次起義。

upheld.zh: 維持、支持（uphold 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The court upheld the original decision.
ex.zh: 法院維持了原判決。

ex.en: She upheld the family's traditions all her life.
ex.zh: 她一生都堅守家族的傳統。

ex.en: The country went through years of political upheaval.
ex.zh: 這個國家經歷了多年的政治動盪。

ex.en: Moving to a new city caused a lot of upheaval in our family.
ex.zh: 搬到新城市讓我們家陷入一陣大變動。

ex.en: The company is in upheaval after the sudden merger.
ex.zh: 公司在突然合併之後陷入一片混亂。

ex.en: She stayed upbeat even when the plan failed.
ex.zh: 即使計畫失敗，她依然保持樂觀。

ex.en: The upbeat music made everyone want to dance.
ex.zh: 輕快的音樂讓每個人都想跳舞。

ex.en: Please read the updated version of the schedule.
ex.zh: 請閱讀更新後的時間表。

ex.en: The website now has an updated design.
ex.zh: 這個網站現在有了更新後的設計。

ex.en: He is quick on the uptake and learns new skills fast.
ex.zh: 他理解很快，學新技能也很快。

ex.en: The teacher was slow on the uptake that the class was confused.
ex.zh: 老師遲遲沒意識到班上同學聽不懂。

ex.en: Plants need light for the uptake of carbon dioxide.
ex.zh: 植物需要光線才能吸收二氧化碳。

ex.en: Exercise can improve the body's uptake of oxygen.
ex.zh: 運動可以增進身體對氧氣的攝取。

ex.en: We spent the holiday in upstate New York.
ex.zh: 我們在紐約州北部度過了假期。

ex.en: She grew up on an upstate farm.
ex.zh: 她在州北部的一座農場長大。

ex.en: They moved upstate to be closer to the mountains.
ex.zh: 他們搬到州北部，離山更近。

ex.en: Heavy snow fell upstate last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚州北部下了大雪。

ex.en: Winters are colder in the upstate.
ex.zh: 州北部的冬天比較冷。

ex.en: The upstate is known for its lakes and farms.
ex.zh: 州北部以湖泊和農場聞名。

ex.en: The salmon swim upstream to lay their eggs.
ex.zh: 鮭魚逆流而上去產卵。

ex.en: We paddled upstream for an hour.
ex.zh: 我們往上游划了一個小時。

ex.en: The upstream factory polluted the river.
ex.zh: 上游的工廠汙染了這條河。

ex.en: Villages upstream got more rain than those downstream.
ex.zh: 上游的村莊比下游的村莊得到更多雨水。

ex.en: The uphill walk to the temple took us an hour.
ex.zh: 走上坡去那間廟花了我們一個小時。

ex.en: Finding a job in this economy is an uphill battle.
ex.zh: 在這種經濟環境下找工作是一場艱難的奮戰。

ex.en: The bus struggled to go uphill in the snow.
ex.zh: 公車在雪地裡吃力地往上坡開。

ex.en: We cycled uphill for almost an hour.
ex.zh: 我們往上坡騎了將近一個小時的腳踏車。

ex.en: There was a sudden upsurge in online shopping last year.
ex.zh: 去年網購突然激增。

ex.en: The city saw an upsurge of interest in cycling.
ex.zh: 這座城市對騎自行車的興趣大增。

ex.en: The upside of working from home is that you save commuting time.
ex.zh: 在家工作的好處是可以省下通勤時間。

ex.en: There is a big upside to learning a second language.
ex.zh: 學第二外語有很大的好處。

ex.en: The painting was hung upside down by mistake.
ex.zh: 那幅畫被誤掛成上下顛倒。

ex.en: The kids love turning everything upside down when they play.
ex.zh: 孩子們玩耍時最愛把東西弄得天翻地覆。

ex.en: The decision caused an uproar among the students.
ex.zh: 這項決定在學生之間引起一陣騷動。

ex.en: The room was in an uproar when the teacher walked out.
ex.zh: 老師走出去後，教室一片喧鬧。

ex.en: The strong wind uprooted several old trees.
ex.zh: 強風把好幾棵老樹連根拔起。

ex.en: We uprooted the weeds from the vegetable garden.
ex.zh: 我們把菜園裡的雜草連根拔除了。

ex.en: The war uprooted thousands of families from their homes.
ex.zh: 戰爭使成千上萬個家庭離開了家園。

ex.en: It was hard to uproot the kids and move to another city.
ex.zh: 要讓孩子們離開熟悉的環境搬到另一個城市並不容易。

ex.en: The books on the uppermost shelf are hard to reach.
ex.zh: 最上層書架上的書很難拿到。

ex.en: Safety is uppermost in our minds when we plan a trip.
ex.zh: 我們規劃旅行時，安全是最優先的考量。

ex.en: Put the heavy box on the bottom with the light ones uppermost.
ex.zh: 把重的箱子放在下面，輕的放在最上面。

ex.en: The flag was placed with the red side uppermost.
ex.zh: 旗子被放成紅色那一面朝上。

ex.en: The cat scratched the upholstery of the sofa.
ex.zh: 貓抓壞了沙發的布面。

ex.en: We had the car's leather upholstery cleaned.
ex.zh: 我們請人清潔了車子的皮革座椅。

ex.en: The upshot of the meeting was that we need more time.
ex.zh: 會議的結果是我們需要更多時間。

ex.en: The upshot is that the trip has been cancelled.
ex.zh: 結論就是旅行取消了。

ex.en: The movie had an uplifting message about never giving up.
ex.zh: 這部電影傳達了一個關於永不放棄的振奮人心的訊息。

ex.en: Her uplifting speech made everyone feel hopeful.
ex.zh: 她令人振奮的演說讓大家充滿希望。

ex.en: The children sat on upturned buckets and watched the show.
ex.zh: 孩子們坐在倒扣的水桶上看表演。

ex.en: He set the upturned boat on the sand to dry.
ex.zh: 他把翻過來的小船放在沙灘上晾乾。

ex.en: They moved to an apartment in uptown last year.
ex.zh: 他們去年搬到上城區的一間公寓。

ex.en: We took the subway uptown to see the museum.
ex.zh: 我們搭地鐵到上城區去參觀博物館。

ex.en: She works at an uptown restaurant.
ex.zh: 她在一家位於上城區的餐廳工作。

ex.en: The uptown streets are quiet in the evening.
ex.zh: 上城區的街道在傍晚很安靜。

upstart.zh: 暴發戶；自命不凡的新貴

ex.en: The old families looked down on the upstart who bought the castle.
ex.zh: 老世家看不起買下那座城堡的暴發戶。

ex.en: Critics called him an upstart who had not earned his place.
ex.zh: 批評者稱他是個靠不住資歷就爬上來的新貴。

uprooted.zh: 連根拔起（uproot 的過去式）

ex.en: The storm uprooted several trees in our street.
ex.zh: 暴風雨把我們街上的幾棵樹連根拔起。

ex.en: War uprooted thousands of families from their homes.
ex.zh: 戰爭使成千上萬的家庭離開家園。

upsetting.zh: 令人難過的；令人心煩的

ex.en: It was upsetting to see the old house torn down.
ex.zh: 看到老房子被拆掉真讓人難過。

ex.en: She heard some upsetting news this morning.
ex.zh: 她今天早上聽到一些令人心煩的消息。

upsetting.zh: 使難過；打翻（upset 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Stop upsetting your little brother.
ex.zh: 別再惹你弟弟難過了。

ex.en: The cat is upsetting the plants again.
ex.zh: 那隻貓又在打翻盆栽了。

ex.en: Don't be so uptight, it's just a party.
ex.zh: 別那麼放不開，這只是個派對。

ex.en: He's uptight about rules and hates breaking them.
ex.zh: 他對規矩很拘謹，討厭違反。

ex.en: I felt uptight before the interview.
ex.zh: 面試前我覺得很緊張。

ex.en: She gets uptight whenever she has to speak in public.
ex.zh: 只要得公開演講，她就會很焦慮。

upriver.zh: 上游的；河流上游方向的

ex.en: We camped at a quiet spot upriver from the town.
ex.zh: 我們在鎮上游處一個安靜的地方露營。

ex.en: The upriver villages get less flood water than those downstream.
ex.zh: 上游的村莊受洪水影響比下游少。

ex.en: They opened an upmarket restaurant in the center of town.
ex.zh: 他們在市中心開了一家高檔餐廳。

ex.en: The brand is trying to move upmarket and attract richer customers.
ex.zh: 這個品牌想往高檔市場發展，吸引更有錢的顧客。

ex.en: The company reported an upswing in sales this year.
ex.zh: 這家公司報告今年銷售額回升。

ex.en: There has been an upswing in tourism lately.
ex.zh: 最近旅遊業出現了好轉。

ex.en: The little dog upstaged the actors on stage.
ex.zh: 那隻小狗在舞台上搶走了演員的風采。

ex.en: She felt upstaged by her younger cousin at the party.
ex.zh: 她覺得在派對上被年紀小的表妹搶了風頭。

ex.en: The actor moved upstage during the final scene.
ex.zh: 演員在最後一幕往舞台後方移動。

ex.en: Please stand upstage so the audience can see everyone.
ex.zh: 請站到舞台後方，這樣觀眾才看得到每個人。

ex.en: We are upgrading our computers this week.
ex.zh: 我們這週正在升級電腦。

ex.en: She is upgrading her seat to business class.
ex.zh: 她正在把座位升級到商務艙。

ex.en: The strong wind upended the garden table.
ex.zh: 強風把花園的桌子吹翻了。

ex.en: The new technology could upend the whole industry.
ex.zh: 這項新技術可能顛覆整個產業。

ex.en: We bought an upholstered chair for the living room.
ex.zh: 我們為客廳買了一張有軟墊的椅子。

ex.en: The restaurant has comfortable upholstered seats.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳有舒適的軟墊座椅。

upholster.zh: 為（沙發等）裝上襯墊與布面

ex.en: We plan to upholster the old chair in green fabric.
ex.zh: 我們打算用綠色布料重新包覆這張舊椅子。

ex.en: He learned how to upholster sofas from his uncle.
ex.zh: 他向叔叔學會了怎麼包覆沙發。

ex.en: We got upgraded seats on the flight.
ex.zh: 我們在航班上被升等到更好的座位。

ex.en: The upgraded phone has a much better camera.
ex.zh: 升級版手機的相機好很多。

ex.en: Please keep your contact information up to date.
ex.zh: 請隨時更新你的聯絡資料。

ex.en: This map is up to date and shows the new bus routes.
ex.zh: 這張地圖是最新的，上面有新的公車路線。

ex.en: Is your phone software up to date?
ex.zh: 你手機的軟體是最新版本嗎？

ex.en: The hospital uses up to date equipment for all its tests.
ex.zh: 這間醫院所有檢查都使用最新的設備。

ex.en: He reads the news every day to stay up to date with world events.
ex.zh: 他每天看新聞，好跟上世界大事。

ex.en: Our teaching methods are modern and up to date.
ex.zh: 我們的教學方法既現代又與時俱進。
